data.name: Anselmi
data.gender_notes: Anselmi is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Latin name Anselmus, Anselmi means 'God's helper'. This name was popular among the Benedictine monks in the Middle Ages, who were known for their piety and devotion to God. The name Anselmi carries the meaning “God's helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anselmi usually hope their child will grow to embody god's helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a deep connection to God and a commitment to helping others.
data.etymology: Anselmi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anselmi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anselmi holds a rich cultural significance in the Christian world, particularly in the history of the Benedictine Monasteries. It conjures up images of piety, learning, and dedication to religious life. The name is reminiscent of a time when monks played an essential role in the development of Western civilization - through their scholarship, liturgical music, and intellectual pursuits.
data.spiritual_significance: Anselmi is a spiritual name that signifies a deep connection with God. It implies a commitment to helping others and serving God through one's actions. In its essence, Anselmi represents the idea of being a co-worker of God, which is a powerful reminder of the ultimate goal in Christian life - to love and serve God in all things.
